title: A quantum must at least pay for one ionization
spoken: h times the frequency is at least the energy to ionize one molecule.
explanation: If one quantum ionizes one molecule, only light whose quantum is at least the ionization energy can ionize the gas at all.
assumptions: One absorbed quantum ionizes at most one molecule.
These are modern teaching equations in SI notation, not a transcription of the printed paper.

notes.title: Planck's constant
notes.explanation: With the frequency, one quantum's energy.

notes.title: Frequency of the light
notes.explanation: It must be high enough for its quantum to reach the ionization energy.

notes.title: Energy to ionize one molecule
notes.explanation: A property of the gas, set against the light's quantum.

notes.title: At least, a threshold
notes.explanation: Below it, no amount of light ionizes the gas in this model. That is the model's consequence, to be checked against experiment.
